rajasthan-golden-triangle.overview: Rajasthan's hiking options include guided treks across Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary, trails at Mount Abu that climb to 1,722-meter Guru Shikhar, and Jaipur's Nahargarh Fort's meandering hill path. Dust haze builds before the monsoon, and smog settles in from November.

taiwan.overview: Taiwan's hiking runs from the marble walls of Taroko Gorge to the high-altitude trails of the Central Mountain Range. The most well known trekking route is the demanding ascent of Yushan, a two-day trek to a 12,970-foot summit that requires a lottery permit. Day hikers can tackle the exposed Zhuilu Old Road cliff path in Taroko, which also needs a permit, or ride the forest railway to Alishan for walks among ancient cypress trees. October and November bring the clearest skies and most comfortable temperatures for the trails.

tbilisi-caucasus.overview: The Georgian Caucasus offers spectacular mountain hiking, from day hikes to remote glaciers to multi-day village routes. The famous four-day, 34-mile trek from Mestia to Ushguli in Svaneti connects ancient stone towers via guesthouse stays. Day hikers heading north from Tbilisi can tackle the steep 3.7-mile round trip to the Gergeti Trinity Church, or push further on the challenging 12-mile round trip to the Gergeti Glacier. The high mountain routes are fully open from July through September.

tierra-del-fuego.overview: Walking at the end of the world means rugged trails through southern beech forests, peat bogs, and jagged peaks overlooking the Beagle Channel. Tierra del Fuego National Park's trail network accesses coastal bays and glacier-fed lakes. For serious trekkers, a flight to Isla Navarino reaches the Dientes de Navarino circuit, a demanding multi-day route through remote, wind-battered alpine terrain.

turks-caicos.overview: Turks and Caicos has a few modest coastal walks for visitors looking to explore beyond the beaches. The best known is the Crossing Place Trail on Middle Caicos, which follows coastal cliffs, while Providenciales has the short Bird Rock Trail.

vancouver-island.overview: Vancouver Island is defined by its rugged Pacific coastline and dense temperate rainforests. The premier route is the West Coast Trail, a demanding 47-mile, six-to-eight-day trek through deep mud, wooden ladders, and remote beaches that requires advance permits. Day hikers can explore shorter boardwalks and coastal paths in Pacific Rim National Park, passing giant cedars and tidal pools.

vermont.overview: Vermont offers classic New England hiking through the dense forests of the Green Mountains. The premier long-distance route is the Long Trail, a rugged 273-mile trek spanning the state, while day hikers tackle the steep, rocky ascents of Mount Mansfield and Camel's Hump for sweeping views over the valleys. Lower elevations provide gentler loops through maple and birch woods.

vienna.overview: Vienna has accessible day hiking in the Vienna Woods, a forested ridge easily reached by train or tram. Walkers can take on easy trails up Kahlenberg for views over the city and the Danube, or explore the shaded paths of the Hagenbachklamm gorge.

whistler.overview: Vancouver and Whistler offer outstanding mountain hiking, from coastal rainforests to the high alpine of Garibaldi Provincial Park. Day hikers can tackle strenuous ascents to glacier-fed lakes and panoramic ridges, or explore lower valley loops. The best alpine routes, like the trails to Garibaldi Lake and Joffre Lakes, require free day passes in summer. The high country is strictly a summer destination, with snow burying the peaks for much of the year.

yellowstone.overview: Yellowstone holds a vast network of trails ranging from geyser basin boardwalks to deep wilderness routes. Day hikers can climb to the Grand Prismatic overlook via the Fairy Falls trail or explore the rim of the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone. Backcountry routes deliver multi-day treks through remote valleys, though hikers must carry bear spray and stay alert for wildlife.

yosemite.overview: Yosemite is home to some of the most spectacular granite and waterfall hiking on Earth. The valley features the steep Mist Trail to Vernal and Nevada Falls, while the famous Half Dome cables require a lottery permit and a strenuous day of climbing. High-country trails off Tioga Road lead to alpine lakes and sweeping domes. The best access runs from June to October when the high passes are clear of snow.

tasmania.overview: Tasmania pairs alpine and coastal hiking. The Overland Track is a six-day, 40-mile trek through the central highlands that needs an advance booking from October to May. Day hikers can climb the steep, rocky ascent of Cradle Mountain's dolerite peaks or follow the coastal trails above Wineglass Bay at Freycinet. The best conditions run from December to February, while the middle of the year brings snow and harsh weather to the highlands.

months.3: March sees cooler temperatures, but the trails remain clear and the hiking conditions are excellent across the island.
months.12: December begins the peak hiking window, with long days and warmer temperatures opening up the entire island's trail network.

months.5: The hiking season peaks with ideal temperatures and vibrant green landscapes across the Val d'Orcia and coastal trails. The Cinque Terre paths start to fill with visitors.
months.6: Summer heat begins to build, making early morning starts necessary for the exposed vineyard and coastal routes. The Cinque Terre paths are busy.
months.7: High summer brings intense heat, making long walks tiring; stick to shaded forest paths or early morning coastal strolls. The Cinque Terre paths are at their most crowded.
months.8: Intense heat continues, so walks are best kept to shaded forest paths or early morning coastal strolls. The Cinque Terre paths stay at their most crowded.
months.9: Temperatures cool, bringing a second peak season for walking among the vineyards during the autumn harvest. The Cinque Terre crowds begin to thin.

zambia.overview: Zambia is the birthplace of the walking safari, offering a rare chance to track wildlife on foot through the bush. The best walking centers on South Luangwa National Park, where guided multi-day walking safaris and day walks follow animal trails along the Luangwa River.
